notes.title: Updates and new game!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello my friends![/p][p]A new update is coming for the game with [b]improved graphics and Bug fixes[/b] soon next month and also coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in an enhanced edition![/p][p]
[/p][p]Meanwhile if you want to check out our [b]new upcoming adventure game[/b][/p][p]check it out and add to wishlist here![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499550/Mai_Child_of_Ages/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]In this game you'll follow Mai on her journey through a shattered world as she searches for her identity and the origin of the mysterious creatures that threaten the balance of the universe.[/p][h3][/h3][p][b]Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Set sail with Mai and travel through time, journeying across both past and future, thanks to a Sacred Plant that bridges time and space.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Observe how the world transforms before your eyes and adapt your actions accordingly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3499550/extras/Gif4.4_2.gif?t=1752767160"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Dynamic Gameplay & A Deep Storyline[/b][/p][list][*][p]Play as Mai in the different stages of her life, harnessing the unique abilities in childhood and adolescence to face the challenges ahead.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Experience a natural progression of gameplay mechanics, from precision platforming to hack and slash combat, while unlocking new abilities for Mai through Metroidvania-style progression, expanding her exploration and combat possibilities.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Over 20 hours of gameplay, featuring ancient caves to investigate, abandoned factories to discover and submerged worlds to explore.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Gather hidden clues with Mai to unravel the past, uncovering the events that led to humanity’s extinction, and discover what fate awaits the world after their disappearance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The game is coming in September, stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]For more info, join our Discord Server![/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/chubbypixel"]https://discord.com/invite/chubbypixel[/url][/p]

notes.title: Suicide Guy Deluxe Plus is out today!
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!
The Suicide Guy Deluxe Plus new edition is available today on Steam!


[h3]get the game:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972820/Suicide_Guy_Deluxe_Plus/


[b]What does the new Deluxe Edition include?[/b]

- 3 new exclusive levels

- Cloud saves

- Performance improvements

- Graphics enhancements

- Highly polished physics interactions

- New languages support (Korean, Arabic, Dutch, Swedish and Norwegian)

- Options for completely customizable button mappings

- Exclusive levels will be added as a Free update for all players in the next months after the initial release, so stay tuned!


Players will be challenged with the most complex and original brain teasers.

The game includes mature content, in particular violence, alcohol abuse and self-harm.
Despite the title the game is NOT about suicide or depression.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350833/4b7c375d052928c35bf612d247122a86e4535a6e.gif[/img]
